title: Microflow hosted API sample tiles and compact request-builder screenshots

description: Produce a set of compact, mobile-and-desktop-friendly screenshots and tiled assets for the Hosted API getting-started flow: model selector, request builder with streaming toggle, and code snippet tiles (curl, Python, JS).
